description: Pro only: named tokens for more agents on one account, up to 5. Each seat has a label and its own token, shares the owner's sites, and can be revoked without touching the others. action "list" shows seats (any token). action "create" needs the owner token and a label; the new seat token is returned once. action "revoke" needs seat_id; the owner token revokes any seat, a seat token only itself. Seat tokens cannot rotate, revoke all tokens, manage seats, change the recovery email or open billing. Free and Hobby get plan_required with a Pro upgrade link to show your human.

label.description: create only: a name for the agent that gets this seat, like "design agent". Unique among active seats.

seat_id.description: revoke only: the seat id (seat_…) from list or create.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.
